verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent service promises an alert as soon as official mail arrives. It also says it scans and uploads the documents, emails the customer with follow-up reminders if unopened, and mails a postcard, so notices trigger prompt notification rather than a periodic mail batch. Missing for 10: explicit mention of service-of-process or lawsuit handling as distinct from other official mail, a stated turnaround time or channels beyond email such as SMS or phone, and independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts are actually immediate.

support.subject: As a founder, a lawsuit or other time-sensitive legal notice triggers an immediate notification rather than waiting on a mail batch

citations.quote: Get an alert as soon as official mail arrives for you

we will upload the documents to your secure cloud storage account, email you to let you know there's mail in your account (including sending reminders if you don't open your email), and mail a postcard
Documents scanned and uploaded for digital access from anywhere
